text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe a hot spring that sprung up so unexpectedly could actually
be this useful to us. When I first saw the showy bathhouse, I didn't know
how to react. But it seems like our guests are enjoying that too.
choice_data_list: Maybe you'll become a hot spring guild.
text_block_list.orig_text:
突発的に湧いた温泉が
こんな形で役に立つなんてね。
最初にあんな派手な浴場を見たときは
反応に困ったけど、
それも込みで
みんな楽しんでくれてるみたいね。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
Maybe she knew what was coming? Which would mean she
really is amazing... Or maybe she simply wanted the limelight...
E-either way, everyone's happy, so it's all good!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここまで見越してたのかしら？
だとしたら本当にすごいけど……
単純に
自己顕示欲な気も……
い、
いえ！
　みんな喜んでるから
いいのよね！

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
They sure can. It might be nothing special to us, but for the townsfolk,
the scenery on the ranch could help them to recuperate. It would be
even better if they could also enjoy interacting with the cows.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうねぇ。
私たちにとっては当たり前だけど、
街の人たちにとって
牧場は景色も癒しなのよね。
牛たちとの触れ合いも楽しめれば、
もっといいのにね。

text_block_list.name: Lima
text_block_list.text:
That does sound like a ton of fun. I'd be chopping down trees, Mahiru
would be taking care of the cows, Shiori would be on guard duty, and
Rin would be... skipping work? Well, that's the dream, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはそれで楽しそうだけど
私が木を切って、
マヒルちゃんが牛たちの世話をして、
シオリちゃんが警備をして、
リンちゃんが……
サボる？
　
そんな牧場が
一番よ。
